branchName.instructions: Branch names come from the Kaneo card: MOD-<number>, e.g. MOD-21 — Leanmt work is filed under the Model Platform project. Base is main.

commitMessage.instructions: Imperative subject under 72 characters naming the subsystem (core, jni, bench, probe, tests). third_party/ stays untouched: if upstream slimt needs a change, it lands as a patch with the reason in the body.

pullRequest.instructions: Open against main; ci-gate is the required check. Body: what changed, the host build and CTest output, whether the Android matrix ran, and any performance numbers quoted from bench/ rather than estimated.
